correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact two-register normal form f0,f1 in Y or absent by recolouring each x-red y fibre; all other tuples blue must have one z per y. A mixed y fibre (two distinct z values) must be covered by at least one register. Three distinct mixed fibres require two tuples each and six-tuples are minimal exactly for types L/R/C with at most one L and at most one R; independent enumeration of weights t,t,2t gives 44 t^3 per y-triple. With two mixed fibres both register assignments (a,d) and (d,a) must fail, giving four-tuple LL/RR and six-tuple L+R on one fibre plus C on the other; counts 2t² and 4t³ per unordered y pair. Zero or one mixed fibre always satisfies, unmixed fibres cannot survive minimality. Explicit six-tuple (b,c)=(2,2) shows sharpness and b=1 or c=1 trivial satisfaction. Independently implemented direct exhaustive splitting and register equivalence for (b,c)=(2,2),(3,2),(2,3), matching exact counts; universal classification follows structural argument, not finite enumeration.
